safe.notes: Family-level extracted benches (all four blocks connected, LO running, upstream baseband and ibias live). Static currents from the DC operating point; transient means over six LO periods. Default-off: en=0 opens bias switches and clamps; island rail off gives no static backfeed. Board contract: RF_TX must be DC-blocked; a DC-coupled source above ~0.5 V on RF_TX with the island rail at 0 V forward-biases the rfdriver PMOS drain junctions (recorded as out-of-contract case).

klayout_drc.tool: KLayout GF180 deck via sak-drc.sh -k (analog image)

extracted_nominal.bench: extracted pt_rfdriver, ideal 2.44 GHz differential input at 2.82 V CM, pad 2 ohm + 1 pF per leg, 50 ohm differential load

board_match.method: board DC feed to the rf_tx island rail through per-leg chokes (Q=30) that resonate the measured differential pad susceptance (tt, code 15, driver biased by the feed); DC blocks; ideal 200:50 ohm balun followed by a 1.0 dB resistive pad for balun insertion loss; 50 ohm load. All board-matched powers are after the balun loss.

observable.notes: ATB taps are exposed as atb_* ports behind ~20 kohm on-block isolation resistors; atb_tap cells, test-bus mux codes and register fields are assigned at integration (analog/island_support, register map), so the test stays open.

routes.control: bypass=1 (debug.rf_tx_bypass): header, pre-amplifiers and all output tails off; PMOS switches connect summed_rf to RF_TX
routes.note: Function shown at low power (-32.1 dBm at 0.3 V baseband); an external PA needs ~32 dB gain to reach 0 dBm.

fallback.notes: bypass_loading_fF = total rfdriver input capacitance on summed_rf with the driver off and bypass open (includes the off bypass PMOS); 140.4 fF with the driver on.

excluded_coverage: No package, bond-wire or supply-network impedance; ideal 3.3 V rails.
LO is an ideal rail-to-rail square wave behind 50 ohm (quadrature block not simulated).
Baseband sources ideal (bbfilter / DAC output impedance not modelled).
No noise or mismatch/Monte Carlo. EVM/ACLR/mask come from a memoryless model fed by the extracted AM-AM/AM-PM (tx_modulation.py), not from a transistor-level modulated transient.
Board: ideal chokes (Q=30), ideal 200:50 balun + 1.0 dB loss pad; balun harmonic rejection not modelled.
rftxpad stress-safe clamp not in the bench: its 2.1 V (ff) onset conflicts with the ~3.3 V pad bias and ~4.1 V peaks of the DC-fed driver (interface-changes.md).
Pad modelled as the rftxpad allocation (2 ohm + 1 pF per leg), not the pads agent extraction.
